name: vibe-loop-git
description: An 8-loop vibe-loop protocol for dark-memory-mcp. Loops 1-6 turn any artifact (code, text, decision, research, video, audio, multi-bundle) into a drift-judged, atomic-mirrored, version-controlled work product. Loop 7 (vibe-flow, vibe_case C8) adds ambient workflow gating: 23 events E1-E23, 25 gates G1-G25, 18 of 20 dark-memory namespaces wired via gate-trigger-matrix.json + gate-protocol.md. Loop 8 (<5min mitigation, L8.1a SHIPPED) adds Layer 1 heuristic classifier: deterministic, zero-LLM-call task-length prediction with per-vibe_case calibration (C1..C8) for the 10 personas (5 technical + 5 cross-cutting) under the cost-lens constraint (dev cost unbounded, user cost minimal). Built on the drift_judge pipeline (Phase 16 SHIPPED) + T-407-c 3-layer defensive pattern (Phase 17 SHIPPED) + C8 vibe_case + 8th vibe_case taxonomy expansion (alpha.30).

C1.label: code
C1.description: Source code change in dark-memory-mcp or downstream projects
C1.driftJudgeIntent: Does the diff match the spec's intent? Are tests aligned? Is backward compat preserved?

C2.label: text
C2.description: Markdown or prose spec / research / decisions
C2.driftJudgeIntent: Does the prose faithfully cite tier-1 sources? Is the conclusion supported by evidence?

C3.label: decision
C3.driftJudgeIntent: Was this decision surfaced at the right time? Are 3 options documented? Is the bias declared?

C4.label: research
C4.canonicalArtifact: mods/vibe-loop-git/core/*-osint*.md OR atomic-mirror row with kind=finding
C4.driftJudgeIntent: Are all claims tier-1 sourced? Are corrections to common misconceptions explicit?

C5.label: video
C5.driftJudgeIntent: Does the subject persist? Does the style hold? Are there AI-slop signals (extra fingers, morphing objects)?

C6.label: audio
C6.driftJudgeIntent: Does the voice persist? Is the noise floor acceptable? Are there hallucinated breaths/clicks?

C7.label: multi
C7.description: Coordinated bundle of independent artifacts (multi-agent subrouter)
C7.driftJudgeIntent: Is each artifact internally consistent? Is the bundle coherent? Are sub-router heuristics correct?

C8.label: vibe-flow
C8.description: Ambient workflow gating: 23 events (E1-E23) fire across a normal dark-memory session; 25 gates (G1-G25) intercept each event with 1-4 dark-memory tool calls; the agent stays in flow via inline notes instead of intrusive blocks. Per vibe-loop-git Loop 7. (Per-artifact cases C1..C7 still apply at the artifact level.)
C8.driftJudgeIntent: Are the 23 gates defined with trigger+tools+failmode? Is the prompt template inject-ready? Are all tool references valid in the live dark-memory registry? Is the philosophy of ambient guidance (not intrusive) preserved?
